_comment: THE CREATURE EVAL CORPUS. Every creature the wish engine should be able to make, spanning the four sourcing tiers a real wish falls into. Deliberately BROAD: earlier evals used three creatures and kept concluding things that did not survive a fourth. Fields: id, prompt (a child's words), tier, sourcing (how hard the reference is to find, and where from), named (the properties the child stated, which are checkable without any reference), reference (a real-world subject, or null for invented). A mod repo shipped most of these as Java mobs built on vanilla bases; Moddy builds them from boxes, so they are a genuinely harder test of the same brief.

prompt: make SONIC THE HEDGEHOG he runs super fast
sourcing: easy — huge franchise, but MANY art styles (classic vs modern vs movie)
reference: Sonic the Hedgehog, modern Sega design

prompt: Now make YOSHI! Yoshi goes after bowser to DEFEAT HIM! Yoshi makes EGGS come out
make barney the dinosaur the big purple one that sings
sourcing: medium — kids TV, plenty of images but fewer clean reference sheets

prompt: make Tralalelo Tralalala the shark with the shoes
sourcing: HARD — Italian-brainrot meme; no official art, sources are meme wikis and short-form video, quality varies wildly

prompt: make a SIGMA BOY
sourcing: HARD — the name is shared by a 2024 song (which has the Wikipedia article) and by the brainrot character (a penguin with a salmon-sushi torso and sashimi hair, documented on the Italian Brainrot Fanon wiki). A measured run took the song and returned a generic human
reference: Sigma Boy (Italian/Russian brainrot character) — penguin with a sushi torso; NOT the song of the same name

prompt: a GINORMUS gorilla boss in the jungle that can pick up anything
sourcing: n/a — a real animal, no character reference needed

prompt: a king T-REX boss that chomps you and shakes you
a huge walking tree monster called the treeanater
a giant scary bloop monster in the deep ocean
make a big troll called Grumbnar with a club
sourcing: n/a — troll is a shared convention

prompt: an icy mage that makes a blizzerd
a fire ghost thing that explodes in fire
an enderman that teleports behind you and blinds you
sourcing: n/a — but leans on a Minecraft mob the agent can look up in the registry

prompt: a crystal golem from minecraft dungeons 2
sourcing: n/a — a sequel that does not exist, so there is no reference to find

prompt: a big buff mutant illusioner boss in a blue ripped robe
a baby ender dragon thats to small to fly yet
a teeny baby wither thats a little trublemaker
a tiny baby warden that wont hurt me
invent me a creature called Zizzle, a spiky orange lizard with three tails
invent a creature called Snorble with four wings and stripey legs and one big eye
sourcing: none — deliberately unusual counts, to test whether stated numbers are honoured
